integrity: Analytical proof with reproducible finite exact/numerical supplementary checks; earlier antiphase cycles and general period-two Jacobian tests explicitly acknowledged as prior work. No independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only strictly positive exchange-swapped period-two orbits in the equal-growth symmetric map are classified; boundary nonlinear behavior, other period-two orbits, basins and stochastic dynamics are not classified.
title: A sharp competition threshold for stable swapping cycles in the symmetric Ricker map
